resources.string: Track one allowance from your electricity bill. Only energy imported from the grid reduces this balance. Exported energy is excluded.
Add the allowance from your bill
The initial measurement is close to the selected date, rather than exactly at midnight. Its actual time is shown above.
No measurement exactly at the end of the period. Unused energy is an estimate based on the last measurement before the deadline.
The last measurement is over 15 minutes old. This is the last known balance.
Remove this local reserve and its saved readings?
Dates use the Europe/Warsaw time zone.
Enter the cumulative grid import reading at the start of this period, summed across all three phases. This is a meter reading, separate from the allowance on your bill.
Search readings near the requested midnight and explicitly confirm one. You can set any search date range. The actual date, time and counter value are shown before saving.
Saving replaces the current configuration and recalculates the entire period from the new initial counter.

Uses the sum of the three active energy import counters. This is an aid for tracking your allowance, rather than a supplier billing calculation. A reset between unavailable measurements may require a manual correction.
This meter is no longer available in the active account.
Account changed. Reopen the meter to load the correct reserve.
Cannot read or save the local configuration. Retry, or remove this reserve and configure it again.
Could not retrieve measurements. Any displayed balance uses the last saved measurement. Check your connection and retry.
Enter a positive allowance in kWh, with at most five decimal places.
Enter a non-negative cumulative initial counter in kWh, with at most five decimal places.
The last day of validity must be on or after the first day.
No suitable historical reading is available. Enter the initial counter manually if configuring the reserve.
Complete active import counters for all three phases are required. Check the meter history.
The measurement is outside the period or older than the saved one. The saved balance has been retained.
No readings in this range. Change the dates or enter the initial counter manually.
Choose and confirm a historical reading within the validity period, or enter the initial counter manually.
Check the period and search dates. The search end cannot precede its start.
Readings are limited to the selected dates, before the validity deadline and no later than now.
